errors.evidence: This information comes from the paper's caption, not the visual content of the figure itself, which does not mention the number of datasets.
The y-axis is labeled "Avgerage Performance" (including the typo). The addition of "(k)" is a hallucination.
The y-axis has labeled tick marks at intervals of 2 units (48, 50, 52, 54, 56).
The labeled y-axis range in the plot starts at 48, not 47.
The increase is not linear. The line is composed of segments with different slopes, indicating that the rate of increase slows down as the number of training datasets grows.
The data point at x=30 is visibly above the horizontal line for the value 56.
The description fails to mention that the line has circular markers at each data point.
